summary.text: Angry Bird is Blazing Heaven Demoness' rank eight level killer move. She rubs an orange-yellow flame into a bird that chirps and flutters around her hand.

claims.text: At Shark Demon’s underwater palace, after an agreement of three moves, she toys with the fire bird instead of striking at once. Fang Yuan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Shark Demon, and Su Bai Man show extremely ugly expressions. They judge that once released it would unleash shocking might: not just the palace, the rest of the shark sea and countless living beings in a huge surrounding area of water might be exterminated by a single blow. Shark Demon asks the name. She says that hundreds of years ago she was careless when cultivating, flames of anger were burning her heart, and she almost lost her life. While recovering she had an inspiration and created this rank eight level killer move. Shark Demon asks her to attack. The angry bird tears through the water, shooting toward him.

A fire bird crashes into Green City Rampage’s chest out of nowhere, explodes, and sends the green giant back. The four supreme elders of Hei tribe shout Blazing Heaven Demoness. Angry bird is a signature killer move of Blazing Heaven Demoness, widely known among Gu Immortals of Northern Plains. She then uses fire prison as a combo: two or more immortal killer moves used one after another have stronger synergy. The crash leaves temporary fire path dao marks. She uses those dao marks as the basis for fire prison, raising its power and trapping the giant.

If a long time had passed, or if she had activated fire prison first, the elders could dodge during activation and the prison would not be as strong. Fang Yuan judges that designing a combo immortal killer move requires great grandmaster attainment.

Three angry birds fuse in the air into a fire phoenix that is neither big nor small, crash into the giant’s arm, and leave a deep hole that green fog mends. Together with phoenix feather triple wing blade, that is another combo, and the arm is chopped off.

When Hei Lou Lan breathes out small fire birds against Fang Yuan’s dragon breath, he thinks of this move and of the Eastern Sea battle, where it left an extremely deep impression on him. The fire birds she uses then are different from the true angry bird. She received Blazing Heaven Demoness’ fire path inheritance and, after Ying Wu Xie refined and gave her those Immortal Gu, could almost replicate Blazing Heaven Demoness’ methods.
Hei Lou Lan uses a group of fire birds that self-detonate. That immortal killer move is Angry Bird. The explosions do not harm Feng Jiu Ge.
She also attacks with it from afar against a green jade song warrior.
Hei Lou Lan activates Crimson Ray, Angry Bird, and Fire Phoenix against an immemorial year monkey. They cause a huge commotion but do little damage.

Known users.text: Blazing Heaven Demoness Hei Lou Lan
